_comment: Post-M5 squad looks (Epic Knights only): each Muster Roll squad wears its own armour kits, carries its own shields, is dyed in its own colours (repeat a colour to weight it) and bears its own arms on its shields. A squad names its look in hywmill_squads. Kits and items that Epic Knights lacks or HYW cannot use are skipped (the culture's gear is used instead).
